people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
translations.bsb: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”
translations.kjv: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
translations.asv: Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead that sought the young child's life.
